annotations.title: CSV to Markdown table: convert CSV into a GitHub table

description:
Convert CSV (comma, semicolon, tab or pipe, detected automatically; quoted fields supported) into a GitHub-flavoured Markdown table, with number columns right-aligned, pipes escaped and line breaks kept as
. Up to 100 KB. Use to show spreadsheet data in a README, chat reply, issue or report; for JSON use csv_to_json. Example: csv=tool,price,calls weather,0.01,120 search,0.01,45. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

header.description: true (default) if the first row holds the column names
